name: Call Notes Sync
changes: When the settings refuse a Pro choice, for example in Link in the daily note (Pro), the keyboard focus now stays on that setting.
In a text field the focus leaves the field, as before.
tip: A meeting younger than 48 hours with no summary and no action items is not ready yet. A later Sync now takes it.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Call Notes Sync is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to bring your meetings into Obsidian.

related.name: Bases Task Rows
related.blurb: See each task from the notes in a base as a separate row.

related.name: Date Property Backlinks
related.blurb: See the notes whose date property matches a daily note, in a Bases view built for you.

related.name: Task Date Links
related.blurb: Adds a real daily note link to a task when you complete it, so backlinks show what you finished each day.
